```{r}
font_add_google("Open Sans")
showtext_auto()

# Define theme_reason based on the uploaded file
theme_reason <- function(base_line_size = 0.5,
                         base_family = "Open Sans",
                         base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_family = base_family,
                base_size = base_size,
                base_line_size = base_line_size) %+replace%
    theme(
      axis.ticks = element_line(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

C1 <- "#CC0100"  # Light orange
```

```{r}

start_year <- 2013
end_year <- 2023

return_data <- read.csv("return_data.csv")

# average return datum and time-series average return in 2004-2023
return_national <- return_data %>% 
  select(fy, month, state, state_abb, plan, plan_abb, gov_type2, return, arr, mva) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(mva) & (fy >= start_year & fy <= end_year)) %>%
  group_by(fy) %>% 
  summarise(
    return = weighted.mean(return, w = mva, na.rm = T),
    arr = weighted.mean(arr, w = mva, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    mean_arr = mean(arr, na.rm = T),
    latest_arr = last(arr, na_rm = T),
    avg_return = prod(1 + return)^(1 / n()) - 1,
    cum_return = cumprod(1 + return)*100
  )
```


```{r}
df_diff_returns <- read_excel("DiffReturnsV3.xlsx", sheet = "DiffReturnsV3")

before_2013_returns <- df_diff_returns %>% 
  filter(fye < 2013) %>% 
  summarise(
    Nevada_PERS_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Nevada_PERS`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Montgomery_County_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Montgomery_County`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Butler_County_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Butler_County`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Harvard_geo_return = (prod(1 + Harvard)^(1/n()) - 1)
  )

after_2013_returns <- df_diff_returns %>% 
  filter(fye >= 2013 & fye <= 2023) %>% 
  summarise(
    Nevada_PERS_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Nevada_PERS`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Montgomery_County_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Montgomery_County`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Butler_County_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Butler_County`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Harvard_geo_return = (prod(1 + Harvard)^(1/n()) - 1)
  )

# Reshape the data to long format
df_diff_returns <- df_diff_returns %>% 
  filter(!is.na(return) & fye >= start_year & fye <= end_year) %>% 
  mutate(
    `Montgomery_cum_return` = cumprod(1 + `Montgomery_County`) * 100,
    `Butler_cum_return` = cumprod(1 + `Butler_County`) * 100,
    `Nevada_PERS_cum_return` = cumprod(1 + `Nevada_PERS`) * 100,
    `Harvard_cum_return` = cumprod(1 + Harvard) * 100,
    `Yale_cum_return` = cumprod(1 + Yale) * 100
  )


# Calculate geometric 10-year means for Nevada PERS, Montgomery County, Butler County, and Harvard
geometric_mean_years <- df_diff_returns %>%
  summarize(
    Nevada_PERS_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Nevada_PERS`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Montgomery_County_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Montgomery_County`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Butler_County_geo_return = (prod(1 + `Butler_County`)^(1/n()) - 1),
    Harvard_geo_return = (prod(1 + Harvard)^(1/n()) - 1)
  )

```

# Figure 1 
```{r}
# Separate Nevada PERS from other plans
nevada_pers <- return_data %>% filter(grepl("Nevada Regular Employees", plan_abb)) %>% 
  select(fy, month, state, state_abb, plan, plan_abb, gov_type2, return, arr, mva) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(mva) & (fy >= start_year & fy <= end_year)) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_return = prod(1 + return)^(1 / n()) - 1,
    cum_return = cumprod(1 + return) * 100
  )
other_plans <- return_data %>% filter(!grepl("Nevada Regular Employees", plan_abb)) %>% 
  select(fy, month, state, state_abb, plan, plan_abb, gov_type2, return, arr, mva) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(mva) & (fy >= start_year & fy <= end_year)) %>%
    group_by(plan) %>% 
    mutate(
      avg_return = prod(1 + return)^(1 / n()) - 1,
      cum_return = cumprod(1 + return)*100
    ) %>% 
    ungroup()

# Plot the data
NPERS <- ggplot() +
  # Plot other plans in the background
  geom_line(data = other_plans, aes(x = fy, y = cum_return, group = plan), color = "gray", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Highlight Nevada PERS
  geom_line(data = nevada_pers, aes(x = fy, y = cum_return), color = "#FF6733", size = 1.2) +
  # Add black line for average cumulative return
  geom_line(data = return_national, aes(x = fy, y = cum_return), color = "black", size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Nevada PERS vs. Other Pension Plans",
       x = "Fiscal Year", y = "Cumulative Return (%)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(start_year, end_year, by = 1), labels = as.character(seq(start_year, end_year, by = 1))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(scale = 1), limits = c(0, 300)) +
  theme_reason()  # Apply the custom Reason theme

print(NPERS)
# Save the plot to the 'outputs' folder with adjusted size to match R preview
# ggsave("outputs/nevada_pers_comparison_percentage.png", plot = NPERS, width = 12, height = 8)
```

# Figure 2 
```{r}
# Separate Nevada PERS from other plans
penn_states <- other_plans %>%
  filter(grepl("Pennsylvania Public School Employees' Retirement System", plan))

# Filter and calculate cumulative returns for Penn Teachers
penn_teachers <- other_plans %>%
  filter(grepl("Pennsylvania State Employees' Retirement System", plan))

penn_states_before_2013 <- return_data %>% 
  filter(grepl("Pennsylvania Public School Employees' Retirement System", plan) & fy < 2013 & fy >= 2003) %>%
  select(fy, month, state, state_abb, plan, plan_abb, gov_type2, return, arr, mva) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mva)) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_return = prod(1 + return)^(1 / n()) - 1  
    )

penn_states_after_2013 <- return_data %>% 
  filter(grepl("Pennsylvania Public School Employees' Retirement System", plan) & fy >= 2013 & fy <= 2023) %>%
  select(fy, month, state, state_abb, plan, plan_abb, gov_type2, return, arr, mva) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mva)) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_return = prod(1 + return)^(1 / n()) - 1
    )

penn_teachers_before_2013 <- return_data %>%
  filter(grepl("Pennsylvania State Employees' Retirement System", plan) & fy < 2013 & fy >= 2003) %>%
  select(fy, month, state, state_abb, plan, plan_abb, gov_type2, return, arr, mva) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mva)) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_return = prod(1 + return)^(1 / n()) - 1  
    )

penn_teachers_after_2013 <- return_data %>%
  filter(grepl("Pennsylvania State Employees' Retirement System", plan) & fy >= 2013 & fy <= 2023) %>%
  select(fy, month, state, state_abb, plan, plan_abb, gov_type2, return, arr, mva) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mva)) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_return = prod(1 + return)^(1 / n()) - 1
    )

df_diff_filtered <- df_diff_returns %>%
  select(-`Nevada_PERS`)

# Plotting the cumulative growth for Nevada PERS, Montgomery County, Butler County, Ohio STRS, and the average cumulative growth
Penn <- ggplot(df_diff_filtered, aes(x = as.numeric(fye))) +
  geom_line(aes(y = `Montgomery_cum_return`, color = "Montgomery County"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = `Butler_cum_return`, color = "Butler County"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(data = penn_states, aes(x = fy, y = cum_return, color = "Penn State"), size = 1.8) +
  geom_line(data = penn_teachers, aes(x = fy, y = cum_return, color = "Penn Teachers"), size = 1.8) +
  # geom_line(data = return_national, aes(x = fy, y = cum_return, color = "Average All Funds"),
  #           size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "10-Year Cumulative Growth (2004 to 2023)",
    x = "Fiscal Year",
    y = "Cumulative Growth (%)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(start_year, end_year, by = 1), labels = as.character(seq(start_year, end_year, by = 1))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(scale = 1), limits = c(100, 250)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Montgomery County" = "#2779CB",
    "Butler County" = "#F6B941",
    "Penn State" = "#66BB8B",
    "Penn Teachers" = "#949D6A"
    # "Average All Funds" = "black"
  )) +
  theme_reason() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# Print the plot
print(Penn)

```
```{r}
# Long-format table comparing returns before and after 2013 of Pennsylvania PSERS, SERS, Montgomery County, and Bulter County
returns_comparison <- data.frame(
  Plan = rep(
    c(
      "Pennsylvania Public School Employees' Retirement System", 
      "Pennsylvania State Employees' Retirement System",
      "Montgomery County",
      "Butler County"
    ),
    each = 2
  ),
  Period = rep(c("Before 2013", "After 2013"), times = 4),
  Geo_Mean_Return = c(
    penn_states_before_2013$avg_return * 100,
    penn_states_after_2013$avg_return * 100,
    penn_teachers_before_2013$avg_return * 100,
    penn_teachers_after_2013$avg_return * 100,
    before_2013_returns$Montgomery_County_geo_return * 100,
    after_2013_returns$Montgomery_County_geo_return * 100,
    before_2013_returns$Butler_County_geo_return * 100,
    after_2013_returns$Butler_County_geo_return * 100)
)



# non-stacked Bar chart to compare geometric means before and after 2013
ggplot(returns_comparison, aes(x = Plan, y = Geo_Mean_Return, 
                                   fill = factor(Period, levels = c("Before 2013", "After 2013")))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Investment Returns Before vs After 2013",
    x = "Retirement Plan",
    y = "Geometric Mean Return (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(4, 8))+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())


```
